newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kawasaki Steel units set up Thai joint venture.
newsitem.headline: Kawasaki Steel units set up Thai joint venture.

text.p: Kawaden Co Ltd said on Wednesday that it and two other Kawasaki Steel Corp subsidiaries had set up an engineering joint venture in Thailand with Rio International (Thailand) Co Ltd on December 1.

The firm, called KMC Asia Co Ltd, is capitalised at five million baht (22 million yen) and is 51 percent owned by Rio International with the rest held by the three Kawasaki Steel subsidiaries, Kawaden said in a statement.
The firm will build power plants and steel mills as well as sell industrial machinery, including cranes, the statement said.
